newsitem.title: INDIA: India proposes changing stainless steel duties.
newsitem.headline: India proposes changing stainless steel duties.

text.p: The Indian government on Wednesday proposed increasing the customs duty on primary forms of stainless steel other than stainless steel slabs to 30 percent from 20 percent.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram told parliament that the government was also proposing to reduce customs duty on stainless steel scrap to 10 percent from 20 percent.

Chidambaram said the reduction in customs duty would help the industry import stainless steel scrap at reasonable prices for the manufacture of blooms, billets and other items, and give it adequate protection against imports of semi-finished goods.
The adjustment in customs duties would take effect upon passage of the Finance Bill by parliament, expected by the end of the week.
